### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues remain for the ScanMalware submission TLP ceiling formatting change. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes #7956 by formatting the ScanMalware submission TLP ceiling for pycti’s comparison helper, preventing `KeyError` on marked observables while preserving separate read and submission limits. **Changes:** - Convert the submission ceiling to uppercase `TLP:XXX` format. - Use pycti’s real TLP comparison in regression tests covering allowed and rejected submissions. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `internal-enrichment/​scanmalware-enrichment/​tests/​tests_connector/​test_connector.py` | Replace the mocked comparison and add CLEAR and AMBER+STRICT ceiling cases. | | `internal-enrichment/​scanmalware-enrichment/​src/​connector/​connector.py` | Format the submission ceiling before calling `check_max_tlp`. |
Review effort: Balanced
